**Management Summary – Project LV 160,242 €**

The audit identified 16 specification gaps, primarily medium‑severity omissions that expose the contract to risk under VOB/C § 4.2 and GEG requirements. Critical missing data include homogen‑area classifications (total €2,555), insulation thickness and thermal conductivity (total €1,690), and water‑exposure class for waterproofing (total €1,120). Additional low‑severity gaps affect paving, asphalt, and concrete details (€1,735). Immediate corrective action should focus on completing all mandatory DIN 18300/18320 homogen‑area entries, insulation and waterproofing parameters, and thermal‑performance data to secure risk allocation and compliance. A targeted revision of the tender documents, followed by a rapid re‑estimate, will mitigate cost overruns and legal exposure.
